questions.q: Which invoice status field does the Validate action specifically control?
options: Approval status
Payment status
Invoice status
Accounting status
questions.explain: Validation determines invoice status; approval, accounting, and payment statuses are tracked separately.

questions.q: Which of these is actually performed by the Validate action?
options: Generating distributions, calculating tax, checking matching variances, and checking GL period status, among other things
Only a spell-check of the invoice description
Automatically approving the invoice
Automatically issuing payment to the supplier
questions.explain: Validation performs substantial real work: generating distributions, calculating tax/withholding, checking matching tolerances, GL period, and currency data.

questions.q: Why can a single invoice come back from validation with multiple different holds at once?
options: Because validation only checks one thing per run and must be run multiple times
Because holds are always applied randomly
Because every invoice always gets every possible hold
Because validation evaluates several independent conditions (matching, period status, funds, etc.) in the same pass rather than stopping at the first failure
questions.explain: Validation checks multiple independent conditions in one pass, so unrelated problems like a price variance and a closed period can both surface together.

questions.q: What does it mean when an invoice reaches 'Validated' status?
options: It has been approved and paid
It has cleared validation checks like distributions, tax, matching, and period status — but approval and payment are still separate
It has been cancelled
It has been merged with another invoice
questions.explain: Validated certifies the invoice itself is clean on those checks; it does not mean approval or payment has happened.

questions.q: What happens during validation if an organization uses budgetary control and funds are insufficient?
options: The invoice is automatically cancelled
The invoice is automatically approved anyway
The supplier's bank account is deactivated
A hold is placed for insufficient funds
questions.explain: Validation reserves funds for budgetary control and places a hold when funds are not available.
